thread:
Alex K: Quick sync — target bump across API + runtime + console + SDKs. Cutoff = Wed 2025-05-14 16:00 PT. Plan: API & runtime must be merged to main by Tue EOD so console/SDKs can pick up and cut their release branches.

Maria S: Clarify — Tue EOD meaning 23:59 PT or Tue business hours? my runtime PR is blocked on a perf regression fix I found in attention kernel.

Samir P: Fix ETA: Tue 10:00 PT. I'll push a hotfix to `release/0.32-candidate` and open a PR to main after CI passes.

Taylor P: SDK note — we depend on a tiny swagger change from API. If that lands unstable we can't do the dep bump. @Maria any breaking schema changes I should worry about?

Maria S: No breaking changes, just an opt-in metrics field (`response.metrics`). Swagger diff is tiny. @Taylor you can start pinning to `api@0.32.0-rc1` once Samir's runtime images are available.

Alex K: Thanks. Checklist reminder: add changelog entry, bump package versions, update integration tests, and tag release candidate images. Use labels `release/0.32` and `release/candidate`.

DevOps-Bot: Created label `release/0.32` and released CI pipeline `release-0.32-candidate`.

Samir P: CI note — canary job added. To run locally:
```
# run canary pipeline
./ci/run_pipeline.sh --pipeline release-0.32-candidate --canary=true
```
Will post canary logs after it finishes.

Taylor P: SDKs will do a minor bump if there are no API breaks. I'll open PRs for `console-sdk` and `node-client` Wednesday morning PT. Will include changelog entries and migration notes.

Alex K: If any repo cannot meet cutoff, call it here before Tue 12:00 PT so we can opt for fallback plan: runtime -> `0.31-compat` images + API soft-fallback routes for two weeks.

Maria S: If perf fix takes longer than expected, we might need that fallback. I'll update by Tue 09:00 PT.

Taylor P: Quick checklist for reviewers: verify `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased, ensure `package.json`/`build.gradle` bump, run `integration/e2e` against `api@0.32-rc` and `runtime@0.32-rc`.

Alex K: Example bump command (run from repo root):
```
./scripts/bump-version.sh 0.32.0 --components api runtime console sdk
git push origin release/0.32
```
Don't forget to include a short one-line summary in the changelog entry.

Samir P: Canary finished: logs stable, small perf regression fixed. Runtime images published: `ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:0.32.0-rc1` and `sha256:abcd1234`.

DevOps-Bot: Deployed candidate images to staging and updated release dashboard.

Taylor P: Picking up swagger and starting SDK PRs now. Will tag with `release/0.32` label once CI green.

ReleaseBot: Reminder scheduled — cutoff ping Tue 12:00 PT.

Alex K: Great work team. Final ask: reviewers please prioritize `release/*` PRs Tue morning. Post any blockers here. :thumbsup:

Maria S: Ack. :thumbsup:

Samir P: Ack, will watch CI and help unblock reviews. :rocket:

Taylor P: Acknowledged — will merge SDK PRs after console patch lands. :shipit:
